name: Naive Bayes (general classification, beyond text)
when_to_use: Classification with categorical (or discretized) predictors, few observations, assuming conditional independence between predictors given the class; complements 22-classificacao-texto-naive-bayes beyond the document-term matrix.
notes: The catalog already has Naive Bayes for text; the general version applies the same probabilistic logic to any categorical variable. Applications: fast classification with few observations and categorical variables, outside the text domain.

expected_input.question: What is the most probable class of a case, combining the probability of each characteristic?

plain_explanation.purpose: Estimates the chance of each category by adding up the evidence from each factor, simply and quickly.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want a fast classifier, even with few examples.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Factor columns (numbers or categories) and the known category.
plain_explanation.example: Predict whether a ticket is urgent from its characteristics.
plain_explanation.diagram: evidence 1 x evidence 2 x ... -> chance per category
